Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. cisa_kev.shortDescription: Siemens Software Center contains an uncontrolled search path element vulnerability that could allow an authenticated local attacker to place a specially crafted DLL in a directory that the application searches, leading to arbitrary code execution with the privileges of the affected application.
cisa_kev.vulnerabilityName: Siemens Software Center Uncontrolled Search Path Element Vulnerability

euvd.description: A vulnerability has been identified in Siemens Software Center (All versions < V4.0.9.8). The affected application loads dynamic-link libraries (DLLs) from an uncontrolled search path. This could allow an authenticated local attacker to place a specially crafted DLL in a directory that the application searches, leading to arbitrary code execution with the privileges of the affected application.

advisory.description: SSA-580366: DLL Sideloading Vulnerability in Siemens Software Center
advisory.summary:
The affected application loads dynamic-link libraries (DLLs) from an uncontrolled search path. This could allow an authenticated local attacker to place a specially crafted DLL in a directory that the application searches, leading to arbitrary code execution with the privileges of the affected application. 

Siemens has released a new version for Siemens Software Center and recommends to update to the latest version. Please refer to our blog post for additional information about current known active exploitation and how to detect it.
